limitations: Eight Darlington output control bits are modeled separately from relay contacts; no load current, isolation or analog voltage simulation.
GPIO4..11 input controls inject digital pad levels. External24V optocoupler transfer is unmodeled.
W5500 Ethernet, PoE power, CAN/RS485 peers, buzzer acoustics and network services are unimplemented.
Source-bounded digital subset only. Original factory execution, browser/WebGL and physical hardware acceptance are separate; no complete compatibility claim.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Hollow case is reconstructed from official exterior dimensions and photographs; wall thickness, unseen internal PCB/components and connector mating tolerance remain UNKNOWN.
Source printed label is restricted to its photographed rectangle. Original photo shadows/material details are not treated as exact geometry.
BOOT and other inputs remain product controls; no guessed through-case 3D hit regions or live indicator positions.
This exact family/variant source photo is used for its printed face. DO transistors and RO relay internals are not interchanged or invented.
Published175x90x40mm envelope is retained. Drawing pixel scale differs between mounting/body annotations; local holes/ports/panel positions are estimates, not precision registration.
The native PCB dimensions, Ethernet/PoE internals, relays/Darlington packages and wiring under the case are UNKNOWN; only a labeled internal PCB envelope is shown.
Open Ethernet/USB envelopes are visual approximations. Blue/green jack color follows common/PoE source photographs, not electrical/network/PoE validation.
